shortDescription: On Polymarket’s “Grizzlies vs. Timberwolves” event, the “Yes” option in the “LaMelo Ball: Points O/U 20.5” submarket fell from 51.5% one hour ago to 26%, a 25.5-percentage-point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the probability was monitored by Catcher Predict.
